scope: Bounded native provider and immediate consumer source review; no cross-owner closure.

consumers.meaning: Native exact selector rejects other directions; strict comparator B < R >; policy extreme low/high, no chronology. BL04 uses policy.direction; BL05 also tests original direction string after validation. External imports conditional.
Right bisect minus one maps timestamp to position, default underflow raises, no upper bound check. Lower bounds left bisect both endpoints; no guarantee of map key alignment or coverage.
Confirmation cache key direction/flag/First/Break/string box edges/conditional intrabar start; omits market generation. Non-None hit can bypass market reads. Caller cache lifetime remains open.

Default true validates start against nominal Break interval; strict first lower crossing or Break open fallback cached; no proof marker. BL05 may scan earlier pending range and BL06 uses main-open prefix, neither is exact-event proof.

Scale builder consumes last confirmed strike main identity/time and semantic extreme, uses full main High/Low for drawing; Reset uses positional first-stop check and stricter beyond-prior source extreme, emits invalid records. These are bounded consumer observations; full BL07–08 W3 next.

Tail supplies map from chronology.candles, Mode A anchor/boundary else prior reaction edge, compares strike count and spacing; update uses caller frontier and local prefix lists, not independent cache or ownership proof.
A owns independently sorted Blue ordinal/source/kind sequence and separate Reaction ordering; native confirmation is precomputed using A route.

A explicitly passes use_intrabar_start=false, unlike Blue default true; no interchangeability of returned chronology timestamps. Native first-reaction gate inclusive with ordered fast path or original linear fallback.
